mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal potential economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by at least 1% from prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption regimes (indicated by 3-month industrial production decline), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 8.5%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 8.5% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs over prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
